830.author: lesyeuxdesabrin
830.text: THATS THE POINT. The clothes and embroidery was copied. It’s literally the Somali style down to even how the sleeves are sewn. Kim Kardashian tried to sell a kimono made with chiffon and was still rightfully called out for cultural appropriation even though chiffon isn’t Japanese
